| AEHR | aehr.com/newsroom (HTTP 200) | 2026-09-03, Lake Street conference — no FY27 Q1 date | 2026-11-02 15:00 ET, intraday (unchanged) | 2026-10-01 |
| APLD | ir.applieddigital.com RSS (HTTP 200) | 2026-07-27 16:05 ET, Q4 FY26 results — no FY27 Q1 date | 2026-10-08 16:00 (unchanged) | 2026-10-06 |

Both are now past the announcement date their own lead times implied (AEHR ~Sep 28 is still ahead; APLD's ~Sep 26 has not arrived yet either — neither is overdue, but APLD is the closer call). LEVI is no longer PENDING — it was confirmed AMC Oct 7 this morning.

**What went wrong:** the 23:00 UTC housekeeping fire started ~2 hours late again (19:00 ET due, 21:00 ET actual) — the same delay measured on 09-21 and 09-22. It does not matter for a housekeeping run, but it is the delay that killed PAYX, DRI and BB, and the `due.py wait` fix has not yet been tested on a real gate.

**Commits:** `26a21a8` — STATE.md cloud run log line and the two re-checks in `event_status.json`, pushed to main. No freeze commit this run, so no BLIND/VOID to report.

**Next:** Mon 2026-09-28 — AIR and JBL, the first live test of the wait-for-the-window fix.
